user.title: Set up PPL CZ
user.description: A mojePPL account can only be signed in one place at a time. Choosing **Account** signs you out of the mojePPL app, and signing back in on the app disconnects Home Assistant until you reconnect it here. **Tracking codes** needs no account, so nothing gets signed out — but you add each parcel's barcode yourself instead of them appearing automatically.

account.title: Set up PPL CZ
account.description:
Enter the e-mail address of your mojePPL account. PPL CZ will send a PIN to that address.

A mojePPL account has one sign-in: setting this up signs the mobile app out, and signing in to the app later disconnects Home Assistant until you reconnect it here.

code.title: Enter the PIN
code.description: Enter the PIN PPL CZ e-mailed to {email}.

reauth_confirm.title: PPL CZ sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: PPL CZ no longer accepts the stored sign-in for {email}. This usually means the account was signed in somewhere else — signing in to the mojePPL app replaces the password Home Assistant stored. Request a new PIN to reconnect.

error.invalid_pin: That PIN was rejected — it may be wrong or expired. Request a new one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach PPL CZ. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: That PPL CZ hub is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That PIN is for a different PPL CZ account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.
